title: 14 November 1963: Live: ABC Cinema, Exeter
content:
This was the second of three occasions on which The Beatles performed at Exeter’s ABC Cinema. The others were 28 March 1963 and 28 October 1964.

14 November 1963 was the 11th date of The Beatles’ 1963 Autumn Tour. They performed a set featuring 10 songs: ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘From Me To You’, ‘All My Loving’, ‘You Really Got A Hold On Me’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Boys’, ‘Till There Was You’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ and ‘Twist And Shout’.
